purpose: Define shared identifiers, references, provenance, rights, and cross-LOC linkage fields. Domain-specific content remains owned by its primary LOC.

system_id.description: Canonical language-system identifier. Current system: lo3rwang.

primary_loc.description: Primary responsibility owner for the record.

related_locs.description: Other LOC domains that analyze, reference, or consume this record.

work_id.description: Stable cross-media work identifier when the record belongs to a work.

media_id.description: Stable media-asset identifier for LOC5 or linked media.

source_refs.description: References to source files, events, works, media, URLs, or registries without duplicating their canonical content.

governance_rules: Authority defines canonical values; consumers reference them.
Do not duplicate canonical ERA names, time boundaries, or language-system identity in downstream modules when a registry reference is available.
Influence, contribution, and rights are separate concepts and must not be inferred from one another.
Mixed-domain records use primary_loc plus related_locs instead of forcing exclusive classification.
LOC8 owns integration, registry, temporal management, and unresolved misc placement; analysis remains owned by LOC6 or LOC7 according to analysis type.
